subject: Standard errors and related  properties for standardized estimates

messages.author: f83c891302b6726d
messages.subject: Standard errors and related  properties for standardized estimates
parts:
Hello,
I'm looking to get the Standard Errors (SE) and p-value for my Standardized estimates. But I see Lavaan only produces the SE for the raw (unstandardized) estimates by default.
Can anyone tell me how to get the additional properties for my standardized estimates?

My summary command is simply: summary(fit, standardized=TRUE, fit.measures=TRUE)

Thanks for any guidance.
a

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: Standard errors and related properties for standardized estimates
parts:
> Any ideas how to get these missing property values for indirect
> standardized estimates?

Not out of the box. You would need to 'manually' compute the
standardized estimates yourselves, by using the := operator. Then, you
can define the indirect effect, again using the := operator. For each
'defined' term, you get a standard error.

Yves.
